newsitem.title: INDIA: Militants kill at least 17 in northeast India.
newsitem.headline: Militants kill at least 17 in northeast India.

text.p: At least 17 people were killed in an ambush by tribal militants in India's remote northeastern state of Tripura early on Tuesday, the United News of India (UNI) reported.
The victims were travelling in two vehicles when the militants opened fire from a hill-top, killing most of them on the spot, UNI said quoting police.
UNI said most of the victims belonged to the paramilitary General Reserve Engineering Force. It said several people were wounded in the ambush.
Further details were awaited, the news agency said.
Dozens of guerrilla groups in northeastern India have been fighting for independent homelands.
